versions.content: If FrNmGlobalPnSupport is set to TRUE, a NM-PDU has been transmitted on a NM-Channel and FrNm_TxConfirmation is called with result E_OK for this NM-PDU, then the FrNm shall forward the confirmation to Nm by calling Nm_PncBitVectorTxConfirmation with the stored PNC bit vector (see SWS_FrNm_00562) for this NM-channel with result set to E_OK
